body: Round 3 is fixed at f62fcad7de, with origin/main merged; normal push. seat_clone_root now refuses when any ancestor of the canonical path, start included: (a) is named aida-seat-*, (b) holds a marker entry of any type, or (c) is the tree of a clone lease in a host main's .aida/sessions. The .git entry is never consulted. Host mains are recorded as main_worktree_root_from resolves them, plus the process cwd's git root. Lease reads are FIFO-safe and never come from the clone. New tests each have a filter.clean canary and a live control: root laid out as a gitdir, nested sub/.git, and a renamed root with no marker (caught only after the host lease is written). task_1787 now has tree_kind. 23 seat_clone tests pass; aida-core 1482 pass; check-ci-fast and check-ci-compile pass. One PTY test, bug_0445_init_side_channel, failed once and passed on rerun; it looks flaky and unrelated.
